description: This file contains implementation of the Sys Setup Manager Object functions, specifically init and stop setup access functions used within the broader system. The functions are placeholders that currently do not perform any operations but are part of the setup process for an access control component.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysSmoInitSetUpAccess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hAccessKey)
methods.description: Initializes setup access for a specified repository folder. Currently a placeholder, returning success without implementation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysSmoStopSetUpAccess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hAccessKey)
methods.description: Stops setup access for a specified repository folder. Currently a placeholder, returning success without implementation.
